facts.fact: The Togolese government portal reports a UNDP and Japan project, implemented by Solafune, to build a digital platform combining satellite and field data for crop monitoring, currently tested over a 1,000 km2 pilot zone in Cinkasse and Tone prefectures, Savanes region.
facts.system: Exploiter la surveillance et l'analyse predictive pour une agriculture adaptee au climat au Togo

systems.system: Climate-adapted agriculture monitoring and predictive analytics platform
